x-rules.seal: manifest_sha256 is SHA-256 of the record excluding that key, serialized as sorted-key JSON with ASCII escapes and no whitespace.
x-rules.identity: bundle_sha256 hashes canonical identity JSON. bytes_per_frame equals width times height times three. Frame files contain tightly packed row-major RGB24 bytes with no headers.
x-rules.frames: Frame indexes are unique and ordered within selection; PTS values, when present, strictly increase. Stored bytes match each frame hash and size.
x-rules.generated: generated is null for original streams, which omit parent_bundle_sha256, recipe and label_transform. Generated bundles require all three and inherit parent identity except transformed frames.
x-rules.labels: label_transform agrees with the deterministic recipe; regions, windows and referenced frames lie inside the parent.
x-rules.time: Measured timestamps require capture clock evidence. Repeated earlier content cannot claim measured capture timing.
